group.name: Brigham and Women's Hospital
group.description: Brigham and Women's Hospital (BWH), world-renowned in virtually every area of adult medicine, is a 777 bed teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School. Consistently ranked by US News & World Report as one of America’s Best Hospitals, BWH’s leadership in state-of-the-art treatments and technologies, patient- and family-focused care, patient quality and safety, and biomedical breakthroughs have improved the health of people around the world.
